ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To bring forward one item and thereby understand three: a compact formula for quick inferential reach. Speakers pair it with weighing the occasion minutely, yet also criticize treating even that facility as sufficient.
EvidenceBody: Yuanwu Keqin uses the phrase in both Blue Cliff Record instruction and his own hall address.
Mi’an Xianjie and Hansong Zhicao place it at the opening of hall statements, with Hansong calling it still inadequate.
Shitian Faxun asks whether such inference establishes the banner, while Dahui Zonggao says it remains at the gate rather than inside.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: To bring forward one item and thereby understand three: a compact formula for quick inferential reach. Speakers pair it with weighing the occasion minutely, yet also criticize treating even that facility as sufficient.
